flow-definition.description:
Mints a new LOGGING_API_KEY for one stack, then redeploys that stack's gateway, visualization and pic-sure-logging containers. Rotating and redeploying are a single operation; there is no option to render without deploying.
Only the selected stack is touched. configs/pic-sure-logging/<stack>/logging.env is that stack's own object, each stack runs its own pic-sure-logging container, and no request crosses between stacks, so the other stack keeps its own key and is never rendered, redeployed or read.
Expect a short window between the Wildfly deploy and the logging deploy where the gateway and visualization already present the new key and pic-sure-logging still checks the old one. It answers those audit events with 401 and the logging client drops them. One key covers all three services, so the two sides cannot cut over at the same instant; the window is a cost of the single-key design rather than a defect.
A fourth consumer is not rendered here, and this job does not finish the rotation on its own. The frontend reads LOGGING_API_KEY from configs/pic-sure-frontend/<stack>/bdc.env, which is uploaded by hand. When this job completes: download this stack's rendered logging.env to read the new key, download the same stack's bdc.env through Download PIC-SURE-Frontend Configuration, set LOGGING_API_KEY to match, upload it through Upload PIC-SURE-Frontend Configuration, and redeploy the frontend. Until that is done the frontend posts the old key and pic-sure-logging drops its audit events; gateway and visualization audit is unaffected. The key is never printed to this job's console.
Per-stack service secrets are not touched. PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN, QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN and AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT are read back out of this stack's rendered env files and preserved. Rotate those with Rotate PIC-SURE Stack Secrets.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_STACK
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: The stack to rotate. Based on selection we determine if is a or b stack. No other stack is touched.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Infrastructure repository revision to render the rotated configuration from. Leave empty to resolve it from build-spec.json.
